question: How do I install a new strike plate on a solid core door without damaging the door or the jamb?
answer: To install a new strike plate on a solid core door, first, ensure the door is in the closed position. Use a pencil to mark the center of the door frame, then use a level to draw a line along the top of the strike plate's mounting screws. Drill pilot holes into the door frame at the marked screw positions. Use a screwdriver to drive the screws into the pilot holes. Align the strike plate with the screw holes and use a screwdriver to secure it in place. Tighten the screws firmly, but avoid overtightening, which can damage the door.
steps: Mark the center of the door frame with a pencil
Draw a line along the top of the strike plate's mounting screws using a level
Drill pilot holes into the door frame at the marked screw positions
Drive the screws into the pilot holes
Align the strike plate with the screw holes
Secure the strike plate with a screwdriver
safety_info: Specific hazard: Striking the door frame or solid core door with a screwdriver or drill bit can cause damage. Specific precaution: Use a pencil to mark the screw positions and a level to ensure accurate alignment, and drill pilot holes before driving screws to avoid damage to the door or jamb.
tips: Use a level to ensure accurate alignment of the strike plate
Use pilot holes to prevent screw splits in the door frame
